programs.title: Toi Time
programs.desc: The Toi Time whanau are excited about going on holiday. Maia makes a caravan to take with them and Aunty Anika sings about her Nana's farm.

programs.title: Waabiny Time
programs.desc: In Noongar Boodgar, Noongar Country there's so much to see. Wano, this way the djet, the flowers and ali bidi, that way you can see the boorn, the trees. Moorditj!

programs.title: Birds Eye View
programs.desc: The birds notice a billboard for a chicken restaurant. Have chickens launched their own branded eatery? When they discover the grim truth they set their minds to vengeance.

programs.title: Aussie Bush Tales
programs.desc: The children sat in the mia-mia waiting for rain to stop, it had been raining caterpillars. When the sun came out, they all decided to go catch a fish in the billabong.

programs.title: The Mysterious Cities Of Gold
programs.desc: The fort is taken by assault from all sides: the villagers, Tao and Atanaos are freed. Esteban manages to inject the antidote to the Raja who regains his spirits and realizes the betrayal of Ambrosius.

programs.title: Bushwhacked
programs.desc: Kayne and Kamil are on a journey to the Epping Forest National Park in central Queensland to meet the once thought extinct, but still critically endangered, Hairy-Nosed Wombat.
